title: Chapter 3 – Karma Yoga (The Yoga of Action)
subtitle: Yoga of Action

verses.title: 3.1 jyayasi chet karmanas
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन ।
तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव ॥ ३-१॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
jyāyasī cetkarmaṇaste matā buddhirjanārdana
tatkiṃ karmaṇi ghore māṃ niyojayasi keśava 3-1
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
jyaayasii chet karmanas te mataa buddhir janaardana
tat kim karmani ghore maam niyojayasi keshava 3-1
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: If you hold that knowledge is greater than action, O Janardana, then why, O Keshava, do you urge me into this dreadful action?

verses.title: 3.2 vyamishreneva vakyena
verses.sanskrit:
व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे ।
तदेकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम् ॥ ३-२॥
verses.roman:
vyāmiśreṇeva vākyena buddhiṃ mohayasīva me
tadekaṃ vada niścitya yena śreyo'hamāpnuyām 3-2
verses.colloquial:
vyaamishrena iva vaakyena buddhim mohayasi iva me
tad ekam vada nishchitya yena shreyah aham aapnuyaam 3-2
verses.translation_reworded: With these seemingly contradictory words you appear to confuse my understanding. So tell me plainly the one path by which I can surely reach the Highest.

verses.title: 3.3 loke smin dvi-vidha
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ ।
ज्ञानयोगेन साङ्ख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम् ॥ ३-३॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
loke'smin dvividhā niṣṭhā purā proktā mayānagha
jñānayogena sāṅkhyānāṃ karmayogena yoginām 3-3
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
loke'smin dvividhaa nishthaa puraa proktaa mayaa anagha
jnaana yogena saankhyaanaam karma yogena yoginaam 3-3
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: In this world there are two paths, as I explained before, O sinless one: the Path of Knowledge followed by the Sankhyans and the Path of Action followed by the Yogins.

verses.title: 3.4 na karmanam anarambhan
verses.sanskrit:
न कर्मणामनारम्भान् न्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते ।
न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति ॥ ३-४॥
verses.roman:
na karmaṇāmanārambhān naiṣkarmyaṃ puruṣo'śnute
na ca saṃnyasanādeva siddhiṃ samadhigacchati 3-4
verses.colloquial:
na karmanaam anaarambhaan naishkarmyam purusho'shnute
na cha samnyasanaad eva siddhim samadhigacchati 3-4
verses.translation_reworded: A person does not reach the state beyond action simply by not acting, nor does anyone attain Perfection through renunciation alone.

verses.title: 3.5 na hi kashchit kshanam
verses.sanskrit:
न हि कश्चित्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत् ।
कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः ॥ ३-५॥
verses.roman:
na hi kaścitkṣaṇamapi jātu tiṣṭhatyakarmakṛt
kāryate hyavaśaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛtijairguṇaiḥ 3-5
verses.colloquial:
na hi kashchit kshanam api jaatu tishthati akarma krit
kaaryate hy avashah karma sarvah prakritijaih gunaih 3-5
verses.translation_reworded: Truly, no one can stay even for a moment without acting, because everyone is driven to act, helplessly, by the qualities that arise from Prakriti.

verses.title: 3.6 karmendriyani sanyamya
verses.sanskrit:
कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन् ।
इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते ॥ ३-६॥
verses.roman:
karmendriyāṇi saṃyamya ya āste manasā smaran
indriyārthānvimūḍhātmā mithyācāraḥ sa ucyate 3-6
verses.colloquial:
karmendriyaani samyamya ya aaste manasaa smaran
indriyaarthaan vimuudhaatmaa mithyaachaarah sa uchyate 3-6
verses.translation_reworded: Someone who holds back the organs of action but sits dwelling on sense objects in the mind is self-deceived and is called a hypocrite.

verses.title: 3.7 yas tvindriyani manasa
verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन ।
कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते ॥ ३-७॥
verses.roman:
yastvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate'rjuna
karmendriyaiḥ karmayogamasaktaḥ sa viśiṣyate 3-7
verses.colloquial:
yastvindriyaani manasaa niyamya aarabhate'rjuna
karmendriyaih karma yogam asaktah sa vishishyate 3-7
verses.translation_reworded: But the person who controls the senses with the mind, O Arjuna, and puts the organs of action to work in Karma Yoga without attachment, is the superior one.

verses.title: 3.8 niyatam kuru karma
verses.sanskrit:
नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः ।
शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः ॥ ३-८॥
verses.roman:
niyataṃ kuru karma tvaṃ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ
śarīrayātrāpi ca te na prasiddhyedakarmaṇaḥ 3-8
verses.colloquial:
niyatam kuru karma tvam karma jyaayo hyakarmanah
shariira yaatraa api cha te na prasiddhyed akarmanah 3-8
verses.translation_reworded: Carry out the duty that is yours to perform, because action is better than inaction. Without action you could not even keep your body alive.

verses.title: 3.9 yajnarthat karmano
verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः ।
तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर ॥ ३-९॥
verses.roman:
yajñārthātkarmaṇo'nyatra loko'yaṃ karmabandhanaḥ
tadarthaṃ karma kaunteya muktasaṅgaḥ samācara 3-9
verses.colloquial:
yajnaarthaat karmanah anyatra lokah ayam karma bandhanah
tadartham karma kaunteya mukta sangah samaachara 3-9
verses.translation_reworded: The world is bound by every action except those done as sacrifice. Therefore, O son of Kunti, act only for that purpose (for yajna), free from all attachment.

verses.title: 3.10 saha-yajnah prajah
verses.sanskrit:
सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः ।
अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक् ॥ ३-१०॥
verses.roman:
sahayajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā purovāca prajāpatiḥ
anena prasaviṣyadhvameṣa vo'stviṣṭakāmadhuk 3-10
verses.colloquial:
saha yajnaah prajaah srishtvaa purovaacha prajaapatih
anena prasavishyadhvam esha vo'stu ishta kaamadhuk 3-10
verses.translation_reworded: At the beginning of creation, Prajapati (the Creator) brought forth humanity along with sacrifice and said: 'Through this you shall prosper; let this be the cow that yields all you wish for' (Kamadhuk, the mythological wish-granting cow).

verses.title: 3.11 devan bhavayatanena
verses.sanskrit:
देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः ।
परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ ॥ ३-११॥
verses.roman:
devānbhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ
parasparaṃ bhāvayantaḥ śreyaḥ paramavāpsyatha 3-11
verses.colloquial:
devaan bhaavayataanena te devaa bhaavayantu vah
parasparam bhaavayantah shreyah parama vaapsyatha 3-11
verses.translation_reworded: Through sacrifice you sustain the gods, and may those devas sustain you in turn. Sustaining one another in this way, you will reach the Highest Good.

verses.title: 3.12 ishtan bhogan hi vo
verses.sanskrit:
इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः ।
तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः ॥ ३-१२॥
verses.roman:
iṣṭānbhogānhi vo devā dāsyante yajñabhāvitāḥ
tairdattānapradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ 3-12
verses.colloquial:
ishtaan bhogaan hi vo devaa daasyante yajna bhaavitaah
tair dattaan apradaayaibhyo yo bhunkte stena eva sah 3-12
verses.translation_reworded: The devas, sustained by sacrifice, will grant you the things you desire. Anyone who enjoys what the devas give without offering anything back to them is nothing but a thief.

verses.title: 3.13 yajna-shishtashinah
verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ।
भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात् ॥ ३-१३॥
verses.roman:
yajñaśiṣṭāśinaḥ santo mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
bhuñjate te tvaghaṃ pāpā ye pacantyātmakāraṇāt 3-13
verses.colloquial:
yajna shishtaashinah santo muchyante sarva kilbishaih
bhunjate te tvagham paapaa ye pachanti aatma kaaranaat 3-13
verses.translation_reworded: The righteous who eat what remains after sacrifice are released from all sins. But the sinful who cook only for themselves eat nothing but sin.

verses.title: 3.14 annad bhavanti bhutani
verses.sanskrit:
अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः ।
यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः ॥ ३-१४॥
verses.roman:
annādbhavanti bhūtāni parjanyādannasambhavaḥ
yajñādbhavati parjanyo yajñaḥ karmasamudbhavaḥ 3-14
verses.colloquial:
annaad bhavanti bhuutaani parjanyaad annasambhavah
yajnaad bhavati parjanyo yajnah karma samudbhavah 3-14
verses.translation_reworded: Living beings come from food; food is produced by rain; rain comes from sacrifice; and sacrifice is born of action.

verses.title: 3.15 karma brahmodbhavam
verses.sanskrit:
कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम् ।
तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥ ३-१५॥
verses.roman:
karma brahmodbhavaṃ viddhi brahmākṣarasamudbhavam
tasmātsarvagataṃ brahma nityaṃ yajñe pratiṣṭhitam 3-15
verses.colloquial:
karma brahma udbhavam viddhi brahma akshara samudbhavam
tasmaat sarvagatam brahma nityam yajne pratishthitam 3-15
verses.translation_reworded: Understand that action originates in Brahmaji (the creator), and Brahmaji originates in the Imperishable. Therefore the all-pervading Brahman (the God-principle) is always present in sacrifice.

verses.title: 3.16 evam pravartitam
verses.sanskrit:
एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः ।
अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति ॥ ३-१६॥
verses.roman:
evaṃ pravartitaṃ cakraṃ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ
aghāyurindriyārāmo moghaṃ pārtha sa jīvati 3-16
verses.colloquial:
evam pravartitam chakram naanuvartayati iha yah
aghaayuh indriya aaraamo mogham paartha sa jiivati 3-16
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever does not keep turning this wheel that has been set in motion lives a sinful life, delighting in the senses. Such a person lives for nothing, O son of Pritha.

verses.title: 3.17 yas tvatma-ratir eva
verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः ।
आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते ॥ ३-१७॥
verses.roman:
yastvātmaratireva syādātmatṛptaśca mānavaḥ
ātmanyeva ca santuṣṭastasya kāryaṃ na vidyate 3-17
verses.colloquial:
yastv aatma ratir eva syaad aatma triptash cha maanavah
aatmani eva cha santushtah tasya kaaryam na vidyate 3-17
verses.translation_reworded: But the person who delights only in the Self, who is satisfied with the Self and content in the Self alone, truly has nothing further to do.

verses.title: 3.18 naiva tasya kritenartho
verses.sanskrit:
नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन ।
न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्चिदर्थव्यपाश्रयः ॥ ३-१८॥
verses.roman:
naiva tasya kṛtenārtho nākṛteneha kaścana
na cāsya sarvabhūteṣu kaścidarthavyapāśrayaḥ 3-18
verses.colloquial:
naiva tasya kritenaartho naakriteneha kashchana
na chaasya sarva bhuuteshu kashchid artha vyapaashrayah 3-18
verses.translation_reworded: Such a person has no stake at all in what is done or left undone in this world, and does not depend on any being for anything.

verses.title: 3.19 tasmad asaktah satatam
verses.sanskrit:
तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर ।
असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः ॥ ३-१९॥
verses.roman:
tasmādasaktaḥ satataṃ kāryaṃ karma samācara
asakto hyācarankarma paramāpnoti pūruṣaḥ 3-19
verses.colloquial:
tasmaad asaktah satatam kaaryam karma samaachara
asaktah hi aacharan karma parama aapnoti puurushah 3-19
verses.translation_reworded: So always perform the actions that ought to be done, without attachment. By acting without attachment a person reaches the Supreme.

verses.title: 3.20 karmanaiva hi sansiddhim
verses.sanskrit:
कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः ।
लोकसङ्ग्रहमेवापि सम्पश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि ॥ ३-२०॥
verses.roman:
karmaṇaiva hi saṃsiddhimāsthitā janakādayaḥ
lokasaṅgrahamevāpi sampaśyankartumarhasi 3-20
verses.colloquial:
karmanaiva hi samsiddhim aasthitaa janakaadayah
lokasangraham evaapi sampashyan kartum arhasi 3-20
verses.translation_reworded: Janaka and others reached Perfection through action alone. You too should act, even if only to protect and guide the people.

verses.title: 3.21 yad yad acharati
verses.sanskrit:
यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः ।
स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते ॥ ३-२१॥
verses.roman:
yadyadācarati śreṣṭhastattadevetaro janaḥ
sa yatpramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanuvartate 3-21
verses.colloquial:
yadyad aacharati shreshthas tattad evetaro janah
sa yat pramaanam kurute lokah tad anuvartate 3-21
verses.translation_reworded: Whatever a great person does, others do as well (they imitate it). Whatever standard such a person sets, the world (the people) follows.

verses.title: 3.22 na me parthasti
verses.sanskrit:
न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन ।
नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि ॥ ३-२२॥
verses.roman:
na me pārthāsti kartavyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana
nānavāptamavāptavyaṃ varta eva ca karmaṇi 3-22
verses.colloquial:
na me paarthaasti kartavyam trishu lokeshu kinchana
naanavaaptam avaaptavyam varta eva cha karmani 3-22
verses.translation_reworded: There is nothing in the three worlds, O Partha, that I need to do, and nothing I lack that I need to obtain. Yet I still engage in action.

verses.title: 3.23 yadi hyaham na varteyam
verses.sanskrit:
यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः ।
मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥ ३-२३॥
verses.roman:
yadi hyahaṃ na varteyaṃ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ 3-23
verses.colloquial:
yadi hyaham na varteyam jaatu karmani atandritah
mama vartma anuvartante manushyaah paartha sarvashah 3-23
verses.translation_reworded: For if I did not always engage in action without pause, people everywhere would follow My example, O son of Pritha.

verses.title: 3.24 utsideyur ime loka
verses.sanskrit:
उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम् ।
सङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः ॥ ३-२४॥
verses.roman:
utsīdeyurime lokā na kuryāṃ karma cedaham
saṅkarasya ca kartā syāmupahanyāmimāḥ prajāḥ 3-24
verses.colloquial:
utsiideyur ime lokaa na kuryaam karma ched aham
sankarasya cha kartaa syaam upahanyaam imaah prajaah 3-24
verses.translation_reworded: If I stopped acting, these worlds would fall to ruin. I would be the cause of the mixing of castes and would bring about the destruction of these beings.

verses.title: 3.25 saktah karmanyavidvanso
verses.sanskrit:
सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत ।
कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसङ्ग्रहम् ॥ ३-२५॥
verses.roman:
saktāḥ karmaṇyavidvāṃso yathā kurvanti bhārata
kuryādvidvāṃstathāsaktaś cikīrṣurlokasaṅgraham 3-25
verses.colloquial:
saktaah karmani avidvaamsah yathaa kurvanti bhaarata
kuryaad vidvaan tathaa asaktah chikiirshur loka sangraham 3-25
verses.translation_reworded: Just as the ignorant act out of attachment to their work, O Bharata, so the wise should act without attachment, seeking the good of the world.

verses.title: 3.26 na buddhi-bhedam
verses.sanskrit:
न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम् ।
जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान्युक्तः समाचरन् ॥ ३-२६॥
verses.roman:
na buddhibhedaṃ janayedajñānāṃ karmasaṅginām
joṣayetsarvakarmāṇi vidvānyuktaḥ samācaran 3-26
verses.colloquial:
na buddhi bhedam janayet ajnaanaam karma sanginaam
joshayet sarva karmaani vidvaan yuktah samaacharan 3-26
verses.translation_reworded: The wise should not disturb the minds of the ignorant who are attached to action. Instead, they should encourage them in all their work while themselves performing it with devotion.

verses.title: 3.27 prakriteh kriyamanani
verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः ।
अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताहमिति मन्यते ॥ ३-२७॥
verses.roman:
prakṛteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśaḥ
ahaṅkāravimūḍhātmā kartāhamiti manyate 3-27
verses.colloquial:
prakriteh kriyamaanaani gunaih karmaani sarvashah
ahankaara vimuudha aatmaa kartaa aham iti manyate 3-27
verses.translation_reworded: In every case, all actions are carried out simply by the qualities of Nature (the gunas). The person whose mind is clouded by egoism thinks, 'I am the doer.'

verses.title: 3.28 tattva-vit tu maha-baho
verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः ।
गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते ॥ ३-२८॥
verses.roman:
tattvavittu mahābāho guṇakarmavibhāgayoḥ
guṇā guṇeṣu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate 3-28
verses.colloquial:
tattvavit tu mahaabaaho guna karma vibhaagayoh
gunaa guneshu vartanta iti matvaa na sajjate 3-28
verses.translation_reworded: But the one who knows the truth, O mighty-armed, about how the qualities divide and how they function, who understands that it is the gunas as senses that move among the gunas as objects, is not attached.

verses.title: 3.29 prakriter guna-sammudhah
verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु ।
तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत् ॥ ३-२९॥
verses.roman:
prakṛterguṇasammūḍhāḥ sajjante guṇakarmasu
tānakṛtsnavido mandānkṛtsnavinna vicālayet 3-29
verses.colloquial:
prakriter guna sammuudhaah sajjante guna karmasu
taan akritsnavido mandaan kritsnavin na vichaalayet 3-29
verses.translation_reworded: Those who are deluded by the qualities of nature (the gunas) become attached to the activities of those qualities. The person of perfect knowledge should not unsettle the foolish, whose knowledge is incomplete.

verses.title: 3.30 mayi sarvani karmani
verses.sanskrit:
मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा ।
निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः ॥ ३-३०॥
verses.roman:
mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi saṃnyasyādhyātmacetasā
nirāśīrnirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigatajvaraḥ 3-30
verses.colloquial:
mayi sarvaani karmaani samnyasya adhyaatma chetasaa
niraashiih nirmamah bhuutvaa yudhyasva vigata jvarah 3-30
verses.translation_reworded: Surrender all your actions to Me, with your mind fixed on the Self, free from expectation and from egoism (the sense of ownership), free from mental fever, and fight!

verses.title: 3.31 ye me matam idam
verses.sanskrit:
ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः ।
श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः ॥ ३-३१॥
verses.roman:
ye me matamidaṃ nityamanutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ
śraddhāvanto'nasūyanto mucyante te'pi karmabhiḥ 3-31
verses.colloquial:
ye me matam idam nityam anutishthanti maanavaah
shraddhaavanto' nasuuyanto muchyante te'pi karmabhih 3-31
verses.translation_reworded: Those who constantly follow this teaching of Mine, with faith and without finding fault, are also set free from the bondage of action.

verses.title: 3.32 ye tvetad abhyasuyanto
verses.sanskrit:
ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम् ।
सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः ॥ ३-३२॥
verses.roman:
ye tvetadabhyasūyanto nānutiṣṭhanti me matam
sarvajñānavimūḍhāṃstān viddhi naṣṭānacetasaḥ 3-32
verses.colloquial:
ye tv etad abhyasuuyanto na anutishthanti me matam
sarva jnaana vimuudhaan taan viddhi nashtaan achetasah 3-32
verses.translation_reworded: But those who sneer at My teaching and do not practise it, confused about all knowledge and lacking discrimination, understand them to be headed for destruction.

verses.title: 3.33 sadrisham cheshtate
verses.sanskrit:
सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि ।
प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति ॥ ३-३३॥
verses.roman:
sadṛśaṃ ceṣṭate svasyāḥ prakṛterjñānavānapi
prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati 3-33
verses.colloquial:
sadrisham cheshtate svasyaah prakriter jnaanavaan api
prakritim yaanti bhuutaani nigrahah kim karishyati 3-33
verses.translation_reworded: Even a wise person acts according to their own nature. All beings follow their nature; what can suppression accomplish?

verses.title: 3.34 indriyasyendriyasyarthe
verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ ।
तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ ॥ ३-३४॥
verses.roman:
indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāgadveṣau vyavasthitau
tayorna vaśamāgacchettau hyasya paripanthinau 3-34
verses.colloquial:
indriyasya indriyasya arthe raaga dveshau vyavasthitau
tayorna vasamagacchettau hyasya paripanthinau 3-34
verses.translation_reworded: Attraction and aversion toward sense objects reside in the senses. No one should fall under their control, because they are a person's enemies.

verses.title: 3.35 shreyan sva-dharmo
verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः ॥ ३-३५॥
verses.roman:
śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt
svadharme nidhanaṃ śreyaḥ paradharmo bhayāvahaḥ 3-35
verses.colloquial:
shreyaan svadharmo vigunah paradharmaat svanushthitaat
svadharme nidhanam shreyah paradharmo bhayaavahah 3-35
verses.translation_reworded: One's own duty, even if it lacks merit, is better than another's duty performed well. It is better to die doing one's own duty; another's duty is full of fear (it brings real danger).

verses.title: 3.36 atha kena prayukto
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः ।
अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः ॥ ३-३६॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
atha kena prayukto'yaṃ pāpaṃ carati pūruṣaḥ
anicchannapi vārṣṇeya balādiva niyojitaḥ 3-36
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
atha kena prayukto'yam paapam charati puurushah
anicchan api vaarshneya balaad iva niyojitah 3-36
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: But what drives a person to commit sin, O Varshneya, even against their own will, as if compelled by force?

verses.title: 3.37 kama esha krodha esha
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः ।
महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम् ॥ ३-३७॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
kāma eṣa krodha eṣa rajoguṇasamudbhavaḥ
mahāśano mahāpāpmā viddhyenamiha vairiṇam 3-37
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
kaama esha krodha esha rajo guna samudbhavah
mahaashanah mahaa paapmaa viddhi enam iha vairinam 3-37
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: It is desire, it is anger, born of the quality of passion (rajas), all-consuming and the source of all sin. Know this to be the enemy here in this world.

verses.title: 3.38 dhumenavriyate vahnir
verses.sanskrit:
धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथादर्शो मलेन च ।
यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम् ॥ ३-३८॥
verses.roman:
dhūmenāvriyate vahniryathādarśo malena ca
yatholbenāvṛto garbhastathā tenedamāvṛtam 3-38
verses.colloquial:
dhuumena aavriyate vahnih yathaadarsho malena cha
yathaa ulbena aavritah garbhah tathaa tena idam aavritam 3-38
verses.translation_reworded: Just as smoke covers fire, dust covers a mirror, and the womb covers the embryo, so this (wisdom) is covered by that (desire or anger).

verses.title: 3.39 avritam jnanam etena
verses.sanskrit:
आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा ।
कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च ॥ ३-३९॥
verses.roman:
āvṛtaṃ jñānametena jñānino nityavairiṇā
kāmarūpeṇa kaunteya duṣpūreṇānalena ca 3-39
verses.colloquial:
aavritam jnaanam etena jnaanino nitya vairinaa
kaama ruupena kaunteya dushpuurena analena cha 3-39
verses.translation_reworded: O son of Kunti, wisdom is covered over by this constant enemy of the wise, which takes the form of desire and, like fire, is never satisfied.

verses.title: 3.40 indriyani mano buddhir
verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते ।
एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम् ॥ ३-४०॥
verses.roman:
indriyāṇi mano buddhirasyādhiṣṭhānamucyate
etairvimohayatyeṣa jñānamāvṛtya dehinam 3-40
verses.colloquial:
indriyaani mano buddhih asya adhishthaanam uchyate
etaih vimohayati esha jnaanam aavritya dehinam 3-40
verses.translation_reworded: The senses, the mind, and the intellect are said to be where it dwells. Working through these, it veils a person's wisdom and deludes the embodied soul.

verses.title: 3.41 tasmat tvam indriyan
verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ ।
पाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम् ॥ ३-४१॥
verses.roman:
tasmāttvamindriyāṇyādau niyamya bharatarṣabha
pāpmānaṃ prajahi hyenaṃ jñānavijñānanāśanam 3-41
verses.colloquial:
tasmaat tvam indriyaani aadau niyamya bharatarshabha
paapmaanam prajahi hy enam jnaana vijnaana naashanam 3-41
verses.translation_reworded: Therefore, O best of the Bharatas, first bring the senses under control, and then destroy this sinful thing, which ruins both knowledge and wisdom.

verses.title: 3.42 indriyani paranyahur
verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः ।
मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः ॥ ३-४२॥
verses.roman:
indriyāṇi parāṇyāhurindriyebhyaḥ paraṃ manaḥ
manasastu parā buddhiryo buddheḥ paratastu saḥ 3-42
verses.colloquial:
indriyaani paraany aahur indriyebhyah param manah
manasas tu paraa buddhir yo buddheh paratas tu sah 3-42
verses.translation_reworded: It is said that the senses are higher than the body; the mind is higher than the senses; the intellect is higher than the mind; and higher even than the intellect is He (the Atman).

verses.title: 3.43 evam buddheh param
verses.sanskrit:
एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना ।
जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम् ॥ ३-४३॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
कर्मयोगो नाम तृतीयोऽध्यायः ॥ ३॥
verses.roman:
evaṃ buddheḥ paraṃ buddhvā saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā
jahi śatruṃ mahābāho kāmarūpaṃ durāsadam 3-43

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
karmayogo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ 3
verses.colloquial:
evam buddheh param buddhvaa samstabhyaatmaanam aatmanaa
jahi shatrum mahaabaaho kaamaruupam duraasadam

om tatsaditi shriimad bhagavad giitaasu upanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
karma yogo naama tritiiyo'dhyaayah 3
verses.translation_reworded:
Knowing Him who is beyond the intellect, and steadying the self by the Self, slay the enemy that takes the form of desire, O mighty-armed, hard though it certainly is to conquer.

So ends the third discourse, called "The Yoga of Action," in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna.
